notes: Implements ADR-2606061359 — collapse the multi-agent org-sim to a single gateway-mediated agent loop (Hermes/OpenClaw model). KEY INSIGHT: the single-agent loop ALREADY EXISTS — `hex do` / direct_exec.rs (ADR-2026-06-04-1740: task->one agent->evidence->commit), and the dashboard already defaults to Direct Runs. So this is a CONSOLIDATION (promote the direct loop, enrich it, retire the org-sim), not a build-from-scratch. Each phase ends with `cargo check --workspace` green; deletions are gated on a full-workspace consumer trace (CLAUDE.md: trace ALL consumers before deleting). Phase 2 is being implemented first because it improves the path we consolidate ONTO before anything is removed.
prompt:
Collapse hex's multi-agent org-sim to a single gateway-mediated agent loop, per ADR-2606061359, matching the Hermes/OpenClaw model (one strong agent + tools + context + memory). hex already runs BOTH models: the old org-sim (33 personas, sched-daemon spawner, org_responder/sop_executor, HexFlo swarms) and the new single-agent direct executor (`hex do` / hex-nexus/src/direct_exec.rs). This workplan consolidates onto the latter and retires the former, in build-gated phases.

PHASE 1 — Default to the single-agent loop (low risk, additive).
  - Make the sched-daemon spawner explicitly opt-in (it is already default-off after the 2026-06-06 quiesce). Document `hex do` as the primary execution path.
  - Confirm the agent-registry is bounded (delete-on-dead — shipped 2026-06-06, ADR-registry fix) so the worker pool can't balloon.
  - Gate: `cargo check --workspace`. No deletions.

PHASE 2 — Enrich the loop with context + memory (Hermes/OpenClaw core). [IMPLEMENTING NOW]
  - direct_exec.rs request_edit: prepend a PROJECT CONTEXT block to the agent prompt, assembled from (a) the target file's GRAPH NEIGHBOURHOOD via hex_graph::context::context_for over graphify-out/graph.json (defines / imports / consumers / community — the structural context that is hex's differentiator), and (b) relevant LESSONS pulled from the hexflo_memory table (key LIKE 'lesson:%'). Both best-effort: any failure yields an empty block and never breaks the loop.
  - This makes the single agent reason with the same structural context the SOP GROUND phase already gets (the graph_context_pack wiring), plus learned lessons (the minimal Hermes-style memory loop).
  - Gate: `cargo check -p hex-nexus`; verify a `hex do run` includes the context block (HEX_DIRECT_DEBUG dump or a unit test on the block builder).

PHASE 3 — Deprecate the org-sim (medium risk, build-gated, no removal yet).
  - Mark the 33 persona YAMLs (hex-cli/assets/agents/hex/hex/) and the SOP dispatch path (org_responder / sop_executor) as DEPRECATED in-code and in docs; reduce the documented roster to the functional worker roles (hex-coder/hex-tester/hex-reviewer) that the direct loop uses.
  - Do NOT delete yet — only mark + stop new code paths from depending on them.
  - Gate: `cargo check --workspace`; grep the ENTIRE workspace to confirm no NEW consumers were added.

PHASE 4 — Remove the dead org-sim + minimal learning loop (higher risk, the teardown).
  - With Phase 3 deprecations settled and consumers traced (sop_executor: ~19 refs, org_responder: ~36 refs as of 2026-06-06 — must reach 0 from live code first), remove the org-sim modules and persona YAMLs in dependency order, `cargo check --workspace` after EACH removal.
  - Standardize lesson:/gap: memory curation as the self-improvement mechanism. Explicitly do NOT adopt the MAPE-K loop (close ADR-2026-05-19-0721 as superseded by ADR-2606061359).
  - Keep HexFlo available as an explicit, capped opt-in primitive for genuine parallel fan-out — not a default.
  - Gate: full `hex dev validate`; a `hex do`-only path proven end-to-end.

CONSTRAINTS: each phase ends green on `cargo check --workspace`; no module deleted until a full-workspace grep shows zero live (non-test) consumers; the direct executor (direct_exec.rs) and `hex do` are the protected target — enrich, don't destabilize. NON-GOALS: rebuilding inference routing (works), removing SpacetimeDB (the substrate stays), vector RAG (later).
